question: Should OpenClaw add a first-party per-agent backup/restore/clone workflow now, and what credential/session portability policy should it use?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the requested feature rewrites persisted config and agent state while handling credentials and transcripts, so automation should not choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Sponsor a core design
options.body: Add a guarded core workflow with explicit archive schema, credential/session portability rules, rollback behavior, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Defer this issue until the broader backup/restore or encrypted snapshot work settles the archive and restore contract.

options.title: Leave to external tooling
options.body: Document manual or plugin/external-tool guidance and keep core backup whole-install only for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core design
recommendation.body: Add a guarded core workflow with explicit archive schema, credential/session portability rules, rollback behavior, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup path-plan work and agentDir compatibility history make this the best available routing owner for the product/security decision.
